title: EventEnvelope
description: Events are a durable stream with consumer groups, at-least-once delivery and ordering within a session partition - not fire-and-forget pub/sub, which silently drops recording.completed when a consumer is down. The envelope is the second of exactly two contact points between the Go and Python halves.

eventId.description: Doubles as the idempotency key for webhook delivery.

version.description: Per-event version. Additive by default; behaviour never changes silently.

sequence.description: Monotonic within the session partition. Ordering is guaranteed here and nowhere else.

traceId.description: W3C trace id. One trace per turn, not per session.

EventType.description: agent.state_changed is the most important event for user experience: a user who can see 'thinking' waits, while a user staring at silence talks over the agent.
